articles.title: Indonesia supports call for prior notice of ballistic missile tests
articles.summary: Indonesia supports an international push for nuclear-armed nations to provide advance warning before testing long-range ballistic missiles. This initiative aims to prevent miscalculation, enhance global stability, and foster transparency in a tense geopolitical environment. Such measures are crucial for international security and arms control, reducing risks of accidental escalation and promoting responsible defence practices.

articles.title: Albanese says Trump giving 'consideration' to tariff exemption after phone call
articles.summary: A prime minister recently engaged in a rare phone call with then-US President Donald Trump to advocate for an exemption from the administration's new sweeping tariffs. The discussion centered on alleviating the economic impact of these trade measures on their nation. President Trump reportedly agreed to give consideration to the request, signaling potential bilateral negotiations on trade policy and economic relations between the two countries.

articles.title: Lanterns' Kyle Chandler Reveals 'Superheroes' He'd Pretend To Be As A Kid, And They're Hilariously On Brand
articles.summary: Actor Kyle Chandler's surprising casting as a co-lead in the upcoming DCU series "Lanterns" has generated buzz. Known for fewer comic book spectacle roles, his involvement in the highly anticipated superhero project marks a notable shift. The DCU series is expected to delve into the vast Green Lantern mythology, featuring advanced sci-fi elements and grand spectacle.

articles.title: Trump Opens Door to Foreign-Built Warships in Major Navy Shipbuilding Overhaul
articles.summary: Former US President Donald Trump ordered a significant overhaul of the US Navy's shipbuilding strategy. Key changes included potentially acquiring foreign-built warships, establishing a fifth public naval shipyard, and modernizing crucial technologies. This initiative aimed to enhance naval capabilities and expand the fleet's capacity for future challenges.

articles.title: Lanterns Confirms How Long Hal Jordan Has Been a DCU Superhero (And It’s Decades More Than Superman)
articles.summary: James Gunn's upcoming Superman movie will establish the new DCU's foundational timeline through an opening title card. This revelation indicates a history spanning three centuries, involving 'met...'—likely metahumans or significant metropolitan developments. This cinematic detail provides crucial context for future storylines and the overall DC Universe narrative.

articles.title: You Can Watch the First Five Minutes of ‘Lanterns’ on YouTube Right Now
articles.summary: HBO Max is launching a new major DC Comics adaptation titled 'Lanterns' to succeed 'House of the Dragon' season three. The series, reportedly starring Kyle Chandler, aims to fill the content void on the streaming platform. This big-ticket production highlights ongoing developments in premium digital entertainment, showcasing how streaming services continuously introduce new content.
